title: Henderson's sophisticated repertoire: rhumbas, waltzes and classics at Roseland
summary: Compared with Carter and Webb, Henderson's band was more advanced, playing tangos, rhumbas, waltzes and classics like Cavalleria Rusticana in dance tempo.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: All right, so Fletcher, we're still with Fletcher. What happened with Fletcher? Was there a big difference between those three bands, Benny Carter, Chick Webb and Fletcher Henderson, I mean from a musician's point of view?

Well, I would say that Fletcher was more advanced than these other bands, because his music -- I'm talking about his music, what he played. Now, when Fletcher worked at Roseland, see you have to play all types of music, not only jazz. You had to play rhumbas, you know, rhumbas, tangos, like they -- because that was for the dancing people, you know. Some people just came to dance tangos, you know, and so you have to play tangos, rhumbas, waltzes were great. Waltzes. And then Fletcher used to -- another thing Fletcher used to
feature, he used to play -- he was one of the bands that used to play the classics in dance tempo.

"Cavalleria Rusticana", and all those things. He was outrageous. Fletcher had a very -- I guess the word -- I don't like it -- is sophisticated, a sophisticated band. And he had the men in the band who could play that music.
